total_model.summary: Model projects 44.0 total points (PIT 26, CLE 18). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.5), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 1.3), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 1.2). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
